name: mi300a
description: AMD Instinct MI300A (CDNA 3, gfx942) at its 2100 MHz peak engine clock: one Vortex core per CU, one cluster per XCD; the XCD is the MI300X's (mi300x).

sources.CU, XCD (all core knobs, NUM_CORES, L2,: Inherited from mi300x: MI300A carries 6 of the MI300X's 8 XCDs (228 CUs), the same 256 MB Infinity Cache and 5.3 TB/s of HBM3, which the CPU dies share (AMD Instinct MI300A data sheet)
sources.reference: fp32_lanes is the vendor FP32 core count (FP32 FMA lanes per chip, clock-free); dram_bandwidth_gbs the vendor peak. Checked by ci/profile_check.py. Latencies inherited from mi300x (MGPUSim's measured MI300X chase: the same XCD, Infinity Cache and HBM3); MGPUSim calibrates against this part too (sarchlab/mgpusim .github/workflows/mi300a_calibration.yml)
